description: ClaimDao.php is a PHP source file implementing the ClaimDao class, which provides data access methods for claim-related entities such as ClaimEvent, ClaimExpense, ClaimRequest, ClaimAttachment, and ExpenseType within the OrangeHRM system. It contains methods for CRUD operations, filtering, pagination, and checking entity usage status.

classes.name: ClaimDao
classes.description: ClaimDao class provides data access methods for managing claim-related entities such as events, expenses, requests, attachments, and expense types. It includes methods for CRUD operations, filtering with pagination, and integrity checks within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: saveEvent
methods.description: Persists a ClaimEvent entity to the database and returns the persisted entity.

methods.name: getClaimEventList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ClaimEvent entities based on filter parameters with pagination.

methods.name: getClaimEventById
methods.description: Fetches a ClaimEvent by its unique ID if not marked as deleted.

methods.name: getExistingClaimEventIds
methods.description: Returns IDs of existing ClaimEvents from a provided list of IDs.

methods.name: deleteClaimEvents
methods.description: Marks specified ClaimEvent entities as deleted based on their IDs.

methods.name: getClaimEventCount
methods.description: Returns the count of ClaimEvents matching the provided filter.

methods.name: saveExpenseType
methods.description: Persists an ExpenseType entity and returns it.

methods.name: saveClaimRequest
methods.description: Persists a ClaimRequest entity and returns it.

methods.name: getNextId
methods.description: Computes the next sequential ID for ClaimRequest entities.

methods.name: getExpenseTypeList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ExpenseType entities filtered by parameters with pagination.

methods.name: getClaimExpenseTypeCount
methods.description: Counts the number of ExpenseType entities matching the filter.

methods.name: getExpenseTypeById
methods.description: Fetches an ExpenseType by ID if not marked as deleted.

methods.name: getExistingExpenseTypeIds
methods.description: Returns IDs of existing ExpenseTypes from a list of IDs.

methods.name: deleteExpenseTypes
methods.description: Marks specified ExpenseType entities as deleted by their IDs.

methods.name: saveClaimExpense
methods.description: Persists a ClaimExpense entity and returns it.

methods.name: getClaimExpenseList
methods.description: Retrieves ClaimExpense entities based on filter parameters with pagination.

methods.name: getClaimExpenseCount
methods.description: Returns count of ClaimExpenses matching filter.

methods.name: getClaimExpenseTotal
methods.description: Calculates the total amount of ClaimExpenses matching the filter.

methods.name: getClaimExpenseById
methods.description: Fetches a ClaimExpense by its ID if not marked as deleted.

methods.name: getClaimRequestExpense
methods.description: Fetches a specific ClaimExpense linked to a ClaimRequest by IDs.

methods.name: getClaimRequestById
methods.description: Retrieves a ClaimRequest by its ID if not deleted.

methods.name: getExistingClaimExpenseIdsForRequestId
methods.description: Returns IDs of ClaimExpenses associated with a specific ClaimRequest ID.

methods.name: deleteClaimExpense
methods.description: Marks ClaimExpense entities as deleted based on claim request ID and entity IDs.

methods.name: saveClaimAttachment
methods.description: Persists a ClaimAttachment entity.

methods.name: getNextAttachmentId
methods.description: Calculates the next available attachment ID for a claim request.

methods.name: getClaimAttachmentList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ClaimAttachment objects based on filter parameters with pagination.

methods.name: getClaimAttachmentCount
methods.description: Returns the count of ClaimAttachments based on filter.

methods.name: getClaimAttachment
methods.description: Fetches a specific ClaimAttachment by request ID and attachment ID.

methods.name: getPartialClaimAttachment
methods.description: Retrieves a summarized partial view of a ClaimAttachment.

methods.name: getClaimAttachmentFile
methods.description: Retrieves a ClaimAttachment entity for download/file access.

methods.name: getExistingClaimAttachmentIdsForRequestId
methods.description: Returns IDs of ClaimAttachments for a specific request.

methods.name: deleteClaimAttachments
methods.description: Deletes (marks as deleted) a list of ClaimAttachments by IDs for a request.

methods.name: getClaimRequestList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ClaimRequest entities with filtering and pagination.

methods.name: getClaimRequestPaginator
methods.description: Configures the query builder for ClaimRequest filtering and pagination.

methods.name: getClaimRequestCount
methods.description: Counts ClaimRequest entities matching filter criteria.

methods.name: getClaimAttachmentFile
methods.description: Retrieves a ClaimAttachment by request and attachment IDs.

methods.name: isClaimEventUsed
methods.description: Checks if a ClaimEvent is referenced in any ClaimRequest.

methods.name: isExpenseTypeUsed
methods.description: Checks if an ExpenseType is used in any ClaimExpense.
